name: Sourav Singh
title: Duty Manager
subtitle: Pre-Opening Resort Operations
biographyText: Dynamic Duty Manager with over 7 years of experience in optimizing operational efficiency and enhancing guest satisfaction across ultra-luxury island resorts and premium branded city properties in the Maldives, Goa, Chennai, and Udaipur.

Demonstrated expertise in directing Front Office shift operations, managing guest experience recovery, and leading pre-opening resort readiness (SOP alignment, service rituals, and luxury touchpoint execution). Proven track record in supervising daily operations, arrivals, departures, VIP handling, and night audit operations in hotels with up to 600 rooms.

Known for building high-performing, service-driven front office teams, fostering a positive work environment, and executing revenue and upselling awareness strategies to contribute to rooms and experience revenue growth.

philosophyIntro: Guided by a commitment to operational efficiency and service excellence, my leadership approach is anchored in six core pillars:

philosophyItems.desc: Elevating brand presentation and guest satisfaction surveys through warm, personalized front office service.
Maximizing yield through proactive room upselling, profile audits, and cross-departmental commercial awareness.
Optimizing operational expenses, front office resource scheduling, and billing accuracy to enhance overall profitability.
Ensuring flawless presentation of the front office, lobby, and guest touchpoints to safeguard asset presentation.
Fostering an inclusive, team-oriented culture where front office staff are empowered to take ownership of service recovery.
Actively celebrating team milestones and guest relations success to maintain high morale and staff retention.
